title: Chapter 4 Quiz 3
description: Three classic calculations on an array.
instructions: Take your time: read each question carefully, then check your answer.

questions.question: tab = [3, 4, 4], and average ← sum DIV 3 is used. What is average?
questions.explanation: The sum is 11, and 11 DIV 3 = 3. Watch out: DIV drops the fraction (the real average is 3.67).

questions.question: To search for the minimum, what should we start with?
options: The index of the first cell
The first element of the array
The average of all the elements
questions.explanation: Starting with the first element works for any values. Watch out: starting at 0 fails when all values are positive, because nothing is smaller.

questions.question: Where does the loop start when min and max begin as tab[1]?
questions.explanation: The first cell is already in min and max, so the loop can start at 2. Watch out: starting at 1 would only repeat the first comparison.

questions.question: Complete the search for the minimum.
questions.code:
min ← tab[1]
For i From 2 To 5 Do
    If tab[i] {{1}} min Then
        min ← {{2}}
    EndIf
EndFor
questions.explanation: If the new element is smaller, it becomes the new min.

questions.question: tab = [15, 7, 22, 3, 19]. Trace min and max from i = 2.
questions.explanation: min is replaced when the element is smaller, max when it is larger. Watch out: a value can leave min and max unchanged.

questions.question: In the minimum search, the test is If tab[i] > min.
questions.explanation: For the minimum we test tab[i] < min. Watch out: the > test is for the maximum.

questions.question: This should find the minimum of tab[1..5]. One line is wrong. Find it and choose the fix.
questions.code:
min ← tab[1]
For i From 2 To 5 Do
    If tab[i] > min Then
        min ← tab[i]
    EndIf
EndFor
questions.explanation: We replace min when the new value is smaller. Watch out: with > the code finds the maximum, and <> would take the last different value.

questions.question: This should read 10 values into array [1..10]. One line is wrong. Find it and choose the fix.
questions.code:
Declare array [1..10] : ARRAY OF integer
For i From 0 To 9 Do
    Read(array[i])
EndFor
Let min ← array[1]
questions.explanation: The cells are numbered 1 to 10. Watch out: the course mixes 0-based and 1-based loops here, and array[0] does not exist.
